decision_conditions: The car parking, servicing and manoeuvring areas shown on the approved drawings shall be provided with a hard, bound, dust-free surface, adequately drained and the respective areas shall be kept free from obstruction at all times, and shall not thereafter be used for any other purposes other than those shown on the approved drawing. Reason: To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or conditions of general safety on adjoining highways and that adequate parking servicing and manoeuvring provision is made in accordance with Policies DM9 (Managing Vehicle Use for New Development) and Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The development shall be completed in accordance with the cycle parking details submitted 07/04/2015. Such facilities shall thereafter be permanently maintained and kept available for cycle parking purposes only and free from obstruction at all times. Reason: To ensure the provision of satisfactory cycling storage facilities and in the interest of highway safety in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The development shall be implemented fully in accordance with the Travel Plan ref: RS/RH/lr/Sb/JNY6206-01C Dated 30th May 2014 and approved in wiring by the Local PLanning Authority 22/09/2012 (ref. 14/10166/FUL).Reason: To ensure that sustainable transport methods are encouraged and implemented in accordance with Policies CS5 (Reducing the Need to Travel) and CS6 (Sustainable Travel) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The development shall be implemented fully in accordance with the details of Sustainable Urban Drainage as detailed in letter K090557/A1/0002 approved in writing by the local planning authority on 23/12/2009 (ref. 09/10226/COND). The system shall be implemented and thereafter managed and maintained in accordance with the approved details. Reason: To prevent the increased risk of flooding in accordance with Policy CS1 (Climate Change Mitigation) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

All plant and machinery shall be enclosed and soundproofed in accordance with the details submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority 23/12/2009 (ref. 09/10226/COND). Such sound insulation shall thereafter be permanently retained. Reason: In order to secure a reduction in the noise emanating there from and in the interest of the residential amenities of the area in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

Refuse storage facilities and recycling facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details shown on drawing K09-0563 SK006, approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority 04/03/2010 (ref. 09/10235/COND) and shall be permanently retained at the site. The refuge storage facilities for the flats hereby approved shall not have access directly on to the frontage. Reason: To ensure the provision of refuse facilities to the satisfaction of the Council in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant other than those shown on the drawings hereby approved shall be installed without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.Reason:  To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring properties and the visual amenities of the area in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The foodstore shall not be open to the public before 8am or after 10pm Mondays to Saturdays, or before 10am or after 5pm on Sundays or Bank Holidays.Reason:  To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring properties and the visual amenities of the area in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

There shall be no occupation of the foodstore, including for internal servicing, outside the hours of 5am and 1am. Between the hours of 11pm and 1am, the occupiers of the foodstore shall comply with the noise management measures set out in the Noise Assessment (NJD25-0175-001R) dated December 2025.Reason:  To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring properties and the visual amenities of the area in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The external lighting details approved 09.05.2018 (ref. 18/10095/COND) shall be installed and retained in perpetuity. Reason:  To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring properties and the visual amenities of the area in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The amenity area to the north west of the building hereby approved shall be permanently retained as amenity space for the occupiers of the apartments and shall not be used for any other purposes.  Reason:  To ensure the retention of the amenity space and to safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring properties and the visual amenities of the area in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The fencing, walls and boundary treatment details approved 04/03/2010 (ref. 09/10235/COND) shall be permanently retained. Reason:  In order to ensure the privacy of adjoining occupiers and visual amenity of the area is retained in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The following management measures will be employed to control noise, light and other disturbance from the operation of the foodstore, including the operational function of deliveries to the store:(a) Two delivery marshalls to be based at the foodstore at all times during opening hours to control the delivery process and facilitate customer parking(b) Delivery vehicle engines must be immediately switched off once the vehicle has docked in the loading dock and must remain off until the vehicle departs(c) The power supply for refrigeration units on delivery vehicles must be turned off prior to arrival at the store(d) Delivery vehicle reversing beepers must be turned off before the vehicle enters the service area. (e) Appropriate signage and chevrons within the service area must be erected to remind drivers to comply with items (b)-(d) and to assist with the delivery manoeuvre and shall be retained at all times. (f) The refresher training register for foodstore employees shall include items (b)-(d) and to shall also require employees to check the service area and loading dock for obstructions prior to delivery vehicle arrivals. (g) Retain the acoustic ceiling in the loading dock to reduce the noise breaking through to the residential unit above.(h) To install a blind on the foodstore window facing Leatherhead Road and to keep the blind lowered outside of store opening hours.Reason:  In order to control noise, light and other disturbance emanating there from and in the interests of the residential amenities of the area in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

Servicing & deliveries to the foodstore shall not take place except between the hours of 8am and 7pm hours on Monday to Saturday and between 10am and 7pm on Sundays & Bank Holidays. Reason:  To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring properties and the visual amenities of the area in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The number of service deliveries to the foodstore shall not exceed 4 deliveries per day on Mondays to Sundays including Bank Holidays. Reason:  To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring properties and the visual amenities of the area in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The development shall be implemented fully in accordance with the Car Park Management details approved in writing by the local planning authority on 23/12/2009 (ref. 09/10226/COND). The car park for the food store shall then be managed in accordance with the car parking management plan for the lifetime of the development. Reason:  To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or conditions of general safety on adjoining highways and that adequate parking servicing and manoeuvering provision is made in accordance with Policies DM9 (Managing Vehicle Use for New Development) and DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

Within one month of consent being granted, a Noise Management Plan shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval, addressing the control of noise from staff working with the food store outside of the permitted store opening hours.  Reason:  To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring properties and the visual amenities of the area in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

There shall be no vehicles, including lorry trailers parked within the car park, servicing area or docking bay outside the house of 5am to 11pm Mondays to Saturday and 7am and 8pm on Sundays or Bank Holidays. Reason:  To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring properties and the visual amenities of the area in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.
description: Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to carry out development without compliance with Condition 8 (opening Time), Condition 9 (Service Time), Condition 14 (Servicing and Deliveries Hour) and Condition 15 (Deliveries Day) of planning permission 15/10326/FUL (Variation of Conditions 4, 5, 7, 8 and 9 of planning permission 08/10283/FUL (erection of 2 storey building compromising 1x retail unit with 12 flats above comprising 2x 1 bed, 8x 2 bed & 2x 3 bed, new access road, car parking and landscaping) (as amended by planning permission 12/10311/FUL ,12/10117/NMA, 14/10166/FUL & 15/10115/FUL) to increase number of deliveries to retail store) to allow changes in opening hours, servicing and delivery time.
